units.text: INT. HUSBAND - CONTINUOUS
What sort of a woman is she?
units.name: MABEL CHILTERN

units.text: Oh! a genius in the daytime and a beauty at night!
units.name: LORD GORING

units.text: I dislike her already.
units.name: MABEL CHILTERN

units.text: That shows your admirable good taste.
units.name: LORD GORING

units.text: Approaching .
Ah, the English young lady is the dragon of good taste, is she not? Quite the dragon of good taste.
units.name: VICOMTE DE NANJAC

units.text: So the newspapers are always telling us.
units.name: LORD GORING

units.text: I read all your English newspapers. I find them so amusing.
units.name: VICOMTE DE NANJAC

units.text: Then, my dear Nanjac, you must certainly read between the lines.
units.name: LORD GORING

units.text: I should like to, but my professor objects.
units.name: VICOMTE DE NANJAC

units.text: To MABEL CHILTERN.
May I have the pleasure of escorting you to the music-room, Mademoiselle?
units.name: VICOMTE DE NANJAC

units.text: Looking very disappointed .
Delighted, Vicomte, quite delighted!
units.name: MABEL CHILTERN

units.text: Turning to LORD GORING.
Aren’t you coming to the music-room?
units.name: MABEL CHILTERN

units.text: Not if there is any music going on, Miss Mabel.
units.name: LORD GORING

units.text: Severely .
The music is in German. You would not understand it.
units.name: MABEL CHILTERN

units.text: Goes out with the VICOMTE DE NANJAC.
LORD CAVERSHAM comes up to his son .

Well, sir! what are you doing here? Wasting your life as usual! You should be in bed, sir. You keep too late hours! I heard of you the other night at Lady Rufford’s dancing till four o’clock in the morning!
units.name: LORD CAVERSHAM

units.text: Only a quarter to four, father.
units.name: LORD GORING

units.text: Can’t make out how you stand London Society. The thing has gone to the dogs, a lot of damned nobodies talking about nothing.
units.name: LORD CAVERSHAM

units.text: I love talking about nothing, father. It is the only thing I know anything about.
units.name: LORD GORING

units.text: You seem to me to be living entirely for pleasure.
units.name: LORD CAVERSHAM

units.text: What else is there to live for, father? Nothing ages like happiness.
units.name: LORD GORING

units.text: You are heartless, sir, very heartless!
units.name: LORD CAVERSHAM

units.text: I hope not, father. Good evening, Lady Basildon!
units.name: LORD GORING

units.text: Arching two pretty eyebrows .
Are you here? I had no idea you ever came to political parties!
units.name: LADY BASILDON

units.text: I adore political parties. They are the only place left to us where people don’t talk politics.
units.name: LORD GORING

units.text: I delight in talking politics. I talk them all day long. But I can’t bear listening to them. I don’t know how the unfortunate men in the House stand these long debates.
units.name: LADY BASILDON

units.text: By never listening.
units.name: LORD GORING

units.text: Really?
units.name: LADY BASILDON

units.text: In his most serious manner .
Of course. You see, it is a very dangerous thing to listen. If one listens one may be convinced; and a man who allows himself to be convinced by an argument is a thoroughly unreasonable person.
units.name: LORD GORING

units.text: Ah! that accounts for so much in men that I have never understood, and so much in women that their husbands never appreciate in them!
units.name: LADY BASILDON

units.text: With a sigh .
Our husbands never appreciate anything in us. We have to go to others for that!
units.name: MRS. MARCHMONT

units.text: Emphatically .
Yes, always to others, have we not?
units.name: LADY BASILDON

units.text: Smiling .
And those are the views of the two ladies who are known to have the most admirable husbands in London.
units.name: LORD GORING

units.text: That is exactly what we can’t stand. My Reginald is quite hopelessly faultless. He is really unendurably so, at times! There is not the smallest element of excitement in knowing him.
units.name: MRS. MARCHMONT

units.text: How terrible! Really, the thing should be more widely known!
units.name: LORD GORING
